title: Field, Input, Textarea
description: Field gives any control a label, a hint and an error, wired for screen readers. Input and Textarea are the standard text controls (bg-field, h-field).
when: Every form control: wrap it in Field instead of writing a <label>.
Text, email, password, search inside forms; multi-line notes.

instead.need: Filter a list in a toolbar

a11y: Field links label (htmlFor), hint and error (aria-describedby) and sets aria-invalid on error.
The error is announced when it appears; required adds a visible mark and aria-required.

examples.title: Error and required
examples.description: Pass error to show the message under the control and mark it invalid.
